notes: All values retrieved 2026-08-16 via web research; every number carries its source. Revenue backbone (1→5→9→14→30→47) is company-confirmed; the Aug 2026 ~$70B point is third-party tracker data that FutureSearch warns 'historically runs hot'.

ECI values are Epoch AI's public-scale ECI only (anchors: Claude 3.5 Sonnet=130, GPT-5=150). Anthropic's internal 'AECI' fork (e.g. Mythos Preview 174/181, Mythos 5 161.29) is NOT comparable and is excluded.

METR values prefer the Time Horizon 1.1 suite (Jan 2026 restatement); TH1.0 used where no TH1.1 value exists (marked). Claude Mythos Preview (≥16h floor, restricted access) and the public Claude 5 family (no METR measurements as of 2026-08-16) mean METR pairing tops out at Opus 4.6.
Old 2026 projections ($20B base / $26B best case, set Oct 2025) were passed by actuals in ~Q1 2026; kept only as context.

Anthropic and its coverage repeatedly describe 2026 growth as compute-gated (Series G/H raised largely for compute; Apr 2026 Broadcom/Google-TPU deal framed as 'the compute to keep pace'), so the fitted revenue-vs-capability slope is, if anything, a supply-constrained understatement of the unconstrained relationship.
